fields.reasoning: Attempt 1's verifier found two problems: f1, existing fixer rules rewritten and dropped, and f2, the Review:/session-done sentence missing. Attempts 2 and 3 made no commit, because the related question fixer-lint-section-over-topic-cap showed that the restored topic costs 994 of 1000 tokens, so an unchanged topic leaves no room for the section. A new lint-fix topic (option b) would add files and a pointer outside the leaf's named files, and it would still need trimming. Shortening wording while keeping every rule (option c) meets what the leaf is for: a fixer that keeps all its existing duties. It touches only the two files the leaf names. It also fixes both of attempt 1's findings directly, since f1 was about rules being lost, not about words changing. Attempt 1's diff shows the existing text can be shortened by roughly the ~120 tokens the section needs.
